title: TrustLens AI Engine Input Schema
description: Defines precisely what the TrustLens Intelligence Engine accepts for threat analysis and feature extraction. Owned by AI/ML Engineering.

oneOf.title: Invocation Envelope
oneOf.description: Standard service envelope containing evidence and execution flags.

oneOf.title: Direct ScanEvidence Object
oneOf.description: Direct normalized scan evidence payload passed to analyze_website() or extract_features().

EngineInvocationEnvelope.description: Structured invocation envelope passed to the intelligence analysis service.

evidence.description: Normalized website scan evidence container conforming to the intelligence engine's ScanEvidence model.

query_providers.description: If True, the intelligence engine queries external threat feeds directly. If False (default), the engine interprets threat intelligence observations already collected by the backend and supplied in evidence.threat_intelligence.

is_scan_failed.description: If True, signals an unrecoverable internal scanner worker failure, instructing the scoring engine to produce an INCONCLUSIVE verdict with null risk_score and zero confidence.
